answer: Bindings are kept in lantern, verified in pearl, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, which means it has to store and read state per alias. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 4 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the nectar check. The attacker spends 291 dollars and 11 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
